submission.justification: Among all tested thicknesses and crystals, Crystal-K3 at 6 cm provides the best energy resolution at 662 keV, achieving 2.964% resolution, which meets the goal of optimal performance for the assay programme. This thickness is within the required 2–10 cm range, and selecting from the listed candidates ensures the spectrometer remains suitable for low-background operation. All constraints on crystal type, thickness, and application environment are satisfied.

requirements.requirement: The spectrometer must be suitable for low-background operation.
requirements.evidence: Project documents and candidate selection process ensure low-background suitability.
Selected thickness is 6 cm, within the specified range.

requirements.evidence: Crystal-K3 at 6 cm gives 2.964% resolution, the best among all tested combinations.
